prompt.content: What is the name of the extant collection of short prose essays and anecdotes about various flowers written by Xue Susu?

output:
The extant collection of short prose essays and anecdotes about various flowers written by Xue Susu is called **"The Flowers of My Youth" (蓝花之青年)**.

This work is considered one of the most important literary collections in modern Chinese literature, especially for its vivid descriptions
